rubric: AGENT.md; 5 criteria x 2 points; passing threshold 8/10.
provenance_caveat: Preserved building evidence lists provider, URL, purpose, byte size and hashes, but does not explicitly record retrieval dates for the source snapshots. This is recorded as a completeness deduction; the independent review date is not substituted for missing source retrieval dates.

sources.provider: Purdue University official campus map / BuildingShapes ArcGIS FeatureServer
sources.source_crs: FeatureServer service native EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100/latestWKID 3857); preserved query geometry coordinates are EPSG:4326 per building evidence.
sources.supports: BRK / Birck Nanotechnology Center / 1205 Mitch Daniels Blvd and the exterior plan ring.
sources.method: Converted lon/lat to project meters with the documented local approximation and translated by the manifest origin; compared source boundary polyline to evaluated base perimeter.
sources.limitations: Public campus GIS polygon is not a certified survey and verifies horizontal plan only.

sources.source_date: 2005 (URL article ID 051008; page content says building completed in September)
sources.supports: Calls the facility two-floor and says a third level houses air-filtration equipment.
sources.limitations: Historic narrative; does not establish current measured heights, floor-to-floor values or current rooftop layout.

sources.supports: Page caption identifies a photo of the Birck Nanotechnology building; visual shows the bronze/brown name volume and glazed front wings.

sources.source_date: Image path contains 2026/01; capture date unreported
sources.supports: Building-specific photo visually shows central bronze-brown cladding with name lettering and flanking curved/angled curtain glazing.
Confirms $100m renovation/enhancement program and cautions older photos may not represent current as-built state.

facade_visual_review.method: Visual cue comparison only. Images are perspective and not camera-registered, so they were not used for orientation, dimensions or metrology.

cues.cue: Broad bronze/brown central cladding volume with building name
cues.source_support: Directly visible in both Purdue images.
cues.model_support: Central bronze/brown facade section and text object appear in fresh render.
cues.status: supported broadly; width, panel seams, sign size and position are not measured.

cues.source_support: Directly visible in both Purdue images.
cues.model_support: Glazed ribbons with aluminum mullion bands flank the center section.
cues.status: supported broadly; exact amount of glazing and module spacing are not measured.

cues.source_support: The ECE 2023 photo shows a curved/angled glazed facade; the official center-site photo shows the wings curving around the center.
cues.model_support: The source GIS perimeter and rendered glazing follow the faceted/curved plan.
cues.status: supported broadly; image is not registered to compass direction and no radius is inferred.

cues.cue: Entrance adjoining glazing and central name wall
cues.source_support: Entry doors are visible in the ECE 2023 photograph and right of the center volume in the center-site photograph.
cues.model_support: Entrance doors and canopy are placed beside the bronze wall in the preview.
cues.status: broad composition supported; exact entrance position/proportion remains approximate.

cues.cue: Rooftop mechanical equipment and interior lobby organization
cues.source_support: Not established by the exterior photos.
cues.status: unverified; no points awarded for detail accuracy.

horizontal_measurement.method: Measured independently from raw FID 604 coordinates and evaluated shell base; detailed numerical outputs in probe_actual.json.
